visual_enhancers.canvas_texture: Subtle #E5E5E3 1px grid pattern or pure alabaster #F9F9F8 with high-precision hairline borders
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E5E3 (always crisp, no blurred double shadows)
visual_enhancers.interactive_feedback: Tactile micro-lifts (hover:-translate-y-[1px]), active:scale-[0.985] on buttons, smooth border-color darken from #E5E5E3 to #111111 on card hover.

transitions.spring_snappy: transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.18s ease, background-color 0.18s ease

motion.ai_pulse: Subtle breathing opacity on the AI indicator (0.4 to 1.0) with an emerald/obsidian dot, not a flashing neon strobe

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's color palette: Canvas #F9F9F8, Surface #FFFFFF, Hairline borders #E5E5E3, Ink #111111, Secondary text #666664, Accent #111111 or #0F766E. Absolutely NO neon, loud gradients, or cartoonish graphics.
Use Geist Variable for sans-serif UI typography and Geist Mono for code/data metrics.

Every sample app (Client Tracker, Habit Log, Event RSVP, Inventory Manager, Personal CRM, Invoice Generator) must be fully functional with working interactive sandboxed iframe previews, real CRUD operations, and live editable data tables.
The builder preview must support realistic device frame toggles (Desktop 100%, Tablet 768px, Phone 375px) with iframe sandbox security.

The Builder chat must support conversational prompts (e.g. 'Add a search bar', 'Change color theme to warm amber', 'Add an export to CSV button') and immediately update the live sandboxed code and version history.
Provide one-click 'Duplicate', 'Visit Live' (/app/:slug), and 'Publish' actions with instant clipboard copy and clean sonner toast notifications.
Ensure every interactive element has a clear role-based data-testid (e.g. data-testid='prompt-submit-btn', data-testid='builder-publish-btn', data-testid='tab-preview-btn').
Never render transparent dropdowns or dialogs; always specify bg-white with 1px border border-[#E5E5E3] and shadow-lg.
Follow base-ui component conventions (no asChild, use render prop or styled links).

accessibility.contrast_check: All text tokens meet APCA and WCAG AA (>4.5:1). #111111 on #F9F9F8 is 17.2:1. #666664 on #FFFFFF is 5.4:1. #0F766E on #FFFFFF is 5.1:1.
accessibility.reduced_motion: All transitions fallback gracefully to instant opacity switches if prefers-reduced-motion is active.
